transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… well, I’m here because people keep saying I’m not seeing things right, especially my husband and some people at the warehouse. I don’t want to sound difficult or anything, but I’m pretty sure they’ve been watching what I do and messing with the pallet counts so I don’t get moved up for that supervisor spot. I just… I figured maybe I should talk to someone, if that makes sense.
Can you tell me more about how you know people are watching you and messing with the pallet counts? Do you feel they are specifically targeting you or acting against your interests?

I mean… I don’t want to sound like I’m accusing everybody, but yeah, it feels like it’s toward me. At the warehouse, I’ll do my counts, and then later they don’t match, like someone changed them or made it look like I messed up. And my husband keeps saying I’m reading into it, but I know they’re watching what I’m doing.

It’s mostly about that supervisor spot. I feel like they don’t want me to get it, so they’re making me look unreliable. Does that… does that make sense?
Do you feel like people are targeting you specifically, or do you sometimes think you have a special role or importance that others don’t recognize?

I don’t think it’s like… I’m special or anything, not like that. I just think they’re targeting me because of the supervisor spot. Like, I know how it sounds, and I’m not trying to cause trouble, but it really feels like people at the warehouse are watching what I do and changing the pallet counts so I look bad.

My husband keeps acting like I’m crazy for saying it, and some people there do too, but… I don’t know, I just know something’s off. Does that answer what you mean?
Have you ever felt like people were watching or targeting you outside of work, like in your personal life or in other situations?

Um… mostly it’s at work. I don’t want to make it sound bigger than it is. It’s just that my husband is involved in it too, or at least he keeps acting like I’m crazy when I bring it up.

But the main thing is the warehouse people watching what I do and the pallet counts changing. It feels like they’re trying to keep me from getting that supervisor spot. I know that probably sounds bad… I’m just trying to explain it right.
Have you ever had times when you felt people were watching or talking about you, even when you were not at work or in situations that didn’t involve the warehouse?

Not really outside of that… or, I mean, not that I can point to the same way. It’s mostly the warehouse stuff.

I came in because my husband and the people at work keep acting like I’m crazy, but I know they’ve been watching my moves there and changing the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot. I know that probably sounds like a lot, but that’s what it feels like is happening.
Have you ever had thoughts that people you don’t know are involved in watching or targeting you, or that things in the media or environment have special meaning for you personally?

No, not really like strangers or the TV or anything having messages for me. I don’t want to make it sound like that.

It’s more… I came in because my husband and the warehouse people keep acting like I’m crazy, but I know they’ve been watching what I do there and changing the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot. That’s the part I’m trying to explain. Does that make sense?
Have you ever had any experiences that others might not understand, or beliefs that you know are different from what most people think are true?

I mean… I guess this is the part people don’t understand. I don’t think it’s some big strange thing, but my husband and the people at the warehouse keep acting like I’m crazy when I say it.

I know they’ve been watching what I do there, watching my moves, and the pallet counts keep getting changed. It feels like they’re doing it so I don’t get that supervisor spot. I’m not trying to sound difficult or anything… that’s just what I’ve been seeing. Does that answer what you mean?
Have you ever had experiences or beliefs where you felt people not connected to work or your husband were watching you, talking about you, or acting against you?

No… I don’t think so. Not people outside of work or my husband, not really.

It’s just the warehouse situation that’s been bothering me. I know it probably sounds bad when I say it, but I feel like they’ve been watching what I do and changing the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot. That’s the main thing. I’m not trying to make it bigger than it is.
Have you questioned whether your belief about the warehouse workers watching you and changing the pallet counts might not be true, or does it feel completely certain to you?

I mean… I’ve tried to tell myself maybe I’m reading it wrong, because I don’t want to sound unreasonable. But it doesn’t really feel like a “maybe” to me.

I know what I’ve been seeing. My husband and the warehouse people keep acting like I’m crazy, but I know they’ve been watching my moves and changing those pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot. I’m not trying to be difficult… it just feels pretty certain. Does that make sense?

Even though others have told you that you might be mistaken about the warehouse workers watching you and changing the pallet counts, does it still feel completely true to you no matter what others say?

Yeah… I mean, I know people keep telling me I could be wrong, and I’m trying to hear that. I don’t want to come across like I’m not listening.

But honestly, it still feels true to me. I came in because my husband and the warehouse people keep acting like I’m crazy, but I know they’ve been watching my moves and changing the pallet counts to keep me from getting that supervisor spot. I wish it didn’t sound so bad when I say it, but that’s what it feels like to me.
Even though your husband and others at the warehouse say you're mistaken about them watching you and changing the pallet counts, does it still feel absolutely true to you, no matter what they say?

Yeah… I’m trying to be open to what you’re saying, I really am. I don’t want to sound like I’m just refusing to listen.

But yes, it still feels true to me. I came in because my husband and the warehouse people keep acting like I’m crazy, but I know they’ve been watching what I do and changing the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot. Even when they say I’m mistaken, it doesn’t really change what I know I’ve seen.
Even though no one else seems to agree with you about the warehouse workers watching you and changing the pallet counts, does it still feel completely true to you, like you just know it in your gut?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to sound stubborn or like I’m trying to argue with everybody. I know no one else is seeing it the way I am.

But in my gut, yes, it feels true. I came in because my husband and the people at the warehouse keep acting like I’m crazy, but I know they’ve been watching what I do and changing the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot. I’m not saying that to be dramatic… it’s just what it feels like I know.
